brief: A personal offline task tracker: add, list, complete tasks; SQLite persists across runs; reject empty titles; no network, authentication, or deployment.

components.name: CLI
components.responsibility: Parse commands; validate input; render result and error exit codes.

components.name: Task Store
components.responsibility: Own SQLite schema and transactional task persistence.

constraints: Python 3.12 standard library only; SQLite; local CLI
No remote service, auth or deployment; data stays in selected local DB

decisions.title: Standard library local CLI
decisions.decision: Use argparse and sqlite3; avoid third party dependencies for this limited offline workflow.
alternatives: Remote API rejected for offline scope
decisions.validation: Implement subprocess integration tests against temporary SQLite file.

name: Offline Task Tracker

requirements.acceptance: Add a title in one process; another process lists that title exactly once.

requirements.description: Complete a known task; reject missing ID and empty titles.
requirements.acceptance: Complete by integer ID; list shows done; invalid input returns nonzero without changing stored tasks.

tasks.title: Implement persistent task store
tasks.acceptance: Temporary database tests prove add, list, complete and invalid-ID behavior.

tasks.title: Implement CLI and integration tests
tasks.acceptance: python -m unittest discover -s tests passes; separate subprocesses prove persistence and error exits.
